app.name: Tasheel Leasing
app.tagline: Digital leasing marketplace and financing intermediation

home.title: Finance your professional equipment, simply
home.subtitle: One file, several financial institutions, offers compared side by side.

business.title: Businesses
business.body: Find your equipment, send one file to several institutions and compare their offers.

supplier.title: Suppliers
supplier.body: Publish your catalogue and make financing a selling point on every item.

institution.title: Banks and leasing companies
institution.body: Receive complete files that match your criteria and manage your proposals online.

disclaimer.intermediary: Tasheel Leasing is a technology intermediation platform. It is neither a bank nor a leasing company. Financing decisions rest solely with the financial institutions.
disclaimer.indicative: Indicative estimate based on your assumptions. Only a proposal issued by a financial institution is an offer.

email.footer: Tasheel Leasing is a technology intermediation platform. It is neither a bank nor a leasing company.
email.ignore: If you did not make this request, you can ignore this message.

verify.subject: Confirm your email address — Tasheel Leasing
verify.body: To activate your account, please confirm your email address. This link is valid for {{hours}} hours.

reset.subject: Reset your password — Tasheel Leasing
reset.body: A password reset was requested for your account. This link is valid for {{minutes}} minutes and can be used once.

passwordChanged.subject: Your password was changed — Tasheel Leasing
passwordChanged.body: Your account password was just changed and all your sessions were signed out. If you did not make this change, contact support immediately.

invite.subject: {{organization}} invites you to Tasheel Leasing
invite.body: {{inviter}} invites you to join {{organization}} on Tasheel Leasing as "{{role}}". This invitation is valid for {{days}} days.

orgVerified.subject: Your organization is verified — Tasheel Leasing
orgVerified.body: {{organization}} has been verified by the Tasheel Leasing team. You now have access to all platform features.

orgRejected.subject: Verification of your organization — Tasheel Leasing
orgRejected.body: The verification of {{organization}} could not be completed. Reason: {{reason}}. You can complete your file and contact support.

orgSuspended.subject: Your organization is suspended — Tasheel Leasing
orgSuspended.body: Access for {{organization}} to Tasheel Leasing is suspended. Reason: {{reason}}. Contact support for more information.

quoteRequested.subject: New quotation request {{reference}} — Tasheel Leasing
quoteRequested.body: {{business}} requests a quotation for "{{listing}}" (quantity: {{quantity}}). Reply from your supplier area.

quoteIssued.subject: Quotation {{reference}} received — Tasheel Leasing
quoteIssued.body: {{supplier}} sent you a quotation for "{{listing}}": {{total}}, valid until {{validUntil}}.

auth.mfaSubtitle: Enter the 6-digit code shown in your authenticator app.
auth.mfaCodeHint: 6-digit code, or one of your recovery codes.

register.title: Create an account
register.subtitle: Register your organization on Tasheel Leasing.
register.consent: I accept the terms of use and the privacy policy, and I authorize the processing of my organization's data.
register.verificationNotice: Your organization will be verified by the Tasheel team before it can use every feature.

reset.forgotSubtitle: We will email you a link to choose a new password.
reset.sent: If an account exists for this address, a link valid for 30 minutes has just been sent.
reset.title: New password
reset.signOutNotice: You will be signed out on all your devices.
reset.done: Your password was changed. Sign in with the new password.

invite.title: Invitation
invite.summary: You are invited to join this organization as "{{role}}" ({{email}}).
invite.wrongAccount: This invitation is addressed to {{email}}. Sign out and sign in with that account.
invite.signInFirst: An account already exists for this address. Sign in to accept the invitation.
invite.createAccount: Create your account to join the organization.

shell.mfaRequiredBody: It is mandatory for your organization. Other pages stay unavailable until it is on.
shell.emailUnverified: Confirm your email address with the link you received.
shell.pendingBody: The Tasheel team is reviewing your file. Complete the organization profile to speed it up.
shell.blockedBody: Access to features is blocked. Contact Tasheel support.
shell.noMembershipBody: Your account is not linked to any active organization. Ask an administrator for an invitation.

dashboard.stepProfile: Complete the organization profile (RC, NIF, wilaya, address)
dashboard.comingSoon: The marketplace, financing applications and offers arrive in the next releases.

org.title: Organization profile
org.identityLocked: Identity verified on {{date}}. To change it, contact Tasheel support.

team.title: Team
team.subtitle: Organization members and invitations.
team.inviteHint: The invitation is valid for 7 days. You can only assign roles whose permissions you all hold.

security.title: Security
security.subtitle: Protect access to your account.
security.requiredBody: Two-step verification is mandatory for your organization. Confirm your password to start.
security.optionalBody: Add a temporary code at each sign-in, generated by an app such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator.
security.step1: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app (or enter the key manually).
security.step2: Enter the 6-digit code shown by the app.
security.recoveryBody: Each code allows one sign-in if you lose your phone. They will not be shown again.
security.enabledBody: Two-step verification protects your account. To generate new recovery codes, enter a code from your app.

admin.documentsLater: Uploading supporting documents comes with the Documents module.
admin.notifyNotice: The organization's administrators will be notified by email. The decision is recorded in the audit log.
admin.auditSubtitle: Every important action, across all organizations.
